0402__L5_SUL_12__7040024B.mp3.asr_text: No one's getting to the summit unless we silence those guns.
0402__L5_SUL_12__7040024B.mp3.translation: 不把那些炮打哑，谁都上不了山顶。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 不把那些炮打哑，谁都上不了山顶。

0403__L5_SUL_10__7023D349.mp3.asr_text: Rest up here for a moment.

0404__L5_POL_13__19D72C69.mp3.asr_text: You know how many caves they got up on that mountain? Those guns could be hidden anywhere up there.
0404__L5_POL_13__19D72C69.mp3.translation: 知道山上有多少洞吗？那些炮藏在哪儿都有可能。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 知道山上有多少洞吗？那些炮藏在哪儿都有可能。

0405__L5_POL_0__535ABBC5.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，鬼子要是这么想要这破岛，送他们算了！这一团糟的鬼地方，除了恶臭和烂丛林，还有……操！该死的虫子！它们跟这破岛可真是绝配！
0405__L5_POL_0__535ABBC5.mp3.note: ASR因超长跳过。未使用AM旧稿补写，待补识别或听音。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，鬼子要是这么想要这破岛，送他们算了！这一团糟的鬼地方，除了恶臭和烂丛林，还有……操！该死的虫子！它们跟这破岛可真是绝配！

0406__L5_POL_61__22433882.mp3.asr_text: Oh, hell. The whole Japanese army could have been hiding in this joint and we'd have never known it. You can't see nothing.
0406__L5_POL_61__22433882.mp3.translation: 妈的，就算整个日本陆军藏在这儿，我们也发现不了。这鬼地方什么都看不见。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 妈的，就算整个日本陆军藏在这儿，我们也发现不了。这鬼地方什么都看不见。

0407__L5_SUL_62__78C83D66.mp3.asr_text: Damn it, Pulaski! Keep that big mouth of yours shut for once!
0407__L5_SUL_62__78C83D66.mp3.translation: 波隆斯基，你就不能闭上你那破嘴吗！
0407__L5_SUL_62__78C83D66.mp3.note: Pulaski疑似Polonsky误识别，结合角色及本关其它喊话统一为波隆斯基。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 波隆斯基，你就不能闭上你那破嘴吗！

0408__L5_MA1_34_1__CC8E6C8A.mp3.asr_text: He's hit! Get out of there!

0411__L5_POL_54__20B8A666.mp3.asr_text: Snipers! Up there on the rocks!

0412__L5_POL_22__1B7DED87.mp3.note: ASR为Enter the gully，按进沟理解；可能存在连读误识别，待听音，不套用旧稿。

0413__L5_SUL_26__722D38EE.mp3.asr_text: We gotta knock out those MGs. Miller, head left and flank their position. We'll cover you.
0413__L5_SUL_26__722D38EE.mp3.translation: 要端掉那些机枪。米勒，从左边绕过去，我们掩护你。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 要端掉那些机枪。米勒，从左边绕过去，我们掩护你。

0417__L5_SUL_76__7AB57409.mp3.asr_text: Best seat in the house. Okay, we've done our part, Marines. The summit's clear for the 27th.
0417__L5_SUL_76__7AB57409.mp3.translation: 看戏的好位置。弟兄们，咱们的活干完了，二十七师可以上山顶了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 看戏的好位置。弟兄们，咱们的活干完了，二十七师可以上山顶了。

0418__L5_POL_71__23F81121.mp3.asr_text: Hey you! Turn around! I said turn around you dumb son of a-
0418__L5_POL_71__23F81121.mp3.translation: 喂！转过身来！叫你转身呢，蠢货……

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 喂！转过身来！叫你转身呢，蠢货……

0419__L5_SUL_11__7031EACA.mp3.asr_text: Quit your belly-aching, Polonsky. We got our orders. The enemy's dug in across this whole damn mountain. And hell if they didn't go up there and hide a couple of 88s.
0419__L5_SUL_11__7031EACA.mp3.translation: 别抱怨了，波隆斯基。命令下来了。敌人在整座山上都挖了工事，居然还藏了几门八八炮。
0419__L5_SUL_11__7031EACA.mp3.note: 八八炮为ASR明确说出的88s，保留游戏录音说法。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 别抱怨了，波隆斯基。命令下来了。敌人在整座山上都挖了工事，居然还藏了几门八八炮。

0421__L5_MA1_16_2__66A6A0CF.mp3.asr_text: Sergeant wants you out front, Marine.
0421__L5_MA1_16_2__66A6A0CF.mp3.translation: 中士叫你到前面去，大兵。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士叫你到前面去，大兵。

0422__L5_POL_34_2__55204CDB.mp3.asr_text: Didn't stand a chance. Once the fuel tanks hit...
0422__L5_POL_34_2__55204CDB.mp3.translation: 根本救不了，燃料罐一中弹就……

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 根本救不了，燃料罐一中弹就……

0423__L5_SUL_49__75C130AF.mp3.asr_text: Keep up the pressure. Roll them up.
0423__L5_SUL_49__75C130AF.mp3.translation: 继续压上去，把他们一窝端了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 继续压上去，把他们一窝端了。

0424__L5_SUL_29__72577F71.mp3.asr_text: Hold your fire! Hold your fire! Marines up ahead!
0424__L5_SUL_29__72577F71.mp3.translation: 停火！停火！前面是自己人！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 停火！停火！前面是自己人！

0425__L5_SUL_15__706A48CE.mp3.asr_text: Spread out and watch for ambush points.

0426__L5_SUL_16__7078604F.mp3.asr_text: Miller, take two men and scout the area up ahead.
0426__L5_SUL_16__7078604F.mp3.translation: 米勒，带两个人去前面侦察。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 米勒，带两个人去前面侦察。

0427__L5_SUL_19__70A2A6D2.mp3.asr_text: Watch that gully! They're trying to flank us!
0427__L5_SUL_19__70A2A6D2.mp3.translation: 盯住那条沟！他们想绕到侧面！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 盯住那条沟！他们想绕到侧面！

0428__L5_SUL_34__73C5E28B.mp3.asr_text: Okay, let's clear out this cave and take it slow, men.
0428__L5_SUL_34__73C5E28B.mp3.translation: 把这个洞清干净，弟兄们，慢点走。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 把这个洞清干净，弟兄们，慢点走。

0429__L5_POL_21__1B6FD606.mp3.asr_text: More of them! In the mouth of that cave!

0433__L5_POL_69__22B3F48A.mp3.asr_text: Heh, that's a switch. Usually they're trying to kill me. Alright, let's see him. Hands in the air!
0433__L5_POL_69__22B3F48A.mp3.translation: 嘿，新鲜了。平时他们只想着杀我。好，让我看看，举起手来！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 嘿，新鲜了。平时他们只想着杀我。好，让我看看，举起手来！

0435__L5_SUL_73__7A8B2D86.mp3.asr_text: God damn it, Polanski, you lucky son of a...
0435__L5_SUL_73__7A8B2D86.mp3.translation: 妈的，波隆斯基，你这走狗运的混蛋……
0435__L5_SUL_73__7A8B2D86.mp3.note: Polanski疑似Polonsky，沿用既定人名波隆斯基。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 妈的，波隆斯基，你这走狗运的混蛋……

0436__L5_POL_74__242257A4.mp3.asr_text: You can't get rid of me that easy, Sergeant. Besides, who's going to keep Miller from fouling up the works, huh?
0436__L5_POL_74__242257A4.mp3.translation: 中士，想甩掉我可没那么容易。再说了，我不在，谁看着米勒不让他捅娄子？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，想甩掉我可没那么容易。再说了，我不在，谁看着米勒不让他捅娄子？

0438__L5_POL_77__244C9E27.mp3.asr_text: Hell, the Japanese are gonna run out of island real soon at this rate.
0438__L5_POL_77__244C9E27.mp3.translation: 照这样打下去，日本人很快就没岛可守了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 照这样打下去，日本人很快就没岛可守了。

0439__L5_SUL_14__705C314D.mp3.asr_text: Artillery makes noise, Polonsky. Just follow the sound and you'll find the guns. That's why the Marine Corps issued those ears, remember?
0439__L5_SUL_14__705C314D.mp3.translation: 炮会响，波隆斯基。顺着声音找，就能找到炮。陆战队给你配这对耳朵就是干这个的，记得吧？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 炮会响，波隆斯基。顺着声音找，就能找到炮。陆战队给你配这对耳朵就是干这个的，记得吧？

0440__L5_MA1_1__B73B6A16.mp3.asr_text: Who's that over there? The 27th? Jeez, looks like those guys are catching hell.
0440__L5_MA1_1__B73B6A16.mp3.translation: 那边是谁？二十七师？天哪，他们被打的好惨。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 那边是谁？二十七师？天哪，他们被打的好惨。

0441__L5_SUL_59__7776094E.mp3.asr_text: Clear the entrance! Couple grenades should finish him!
0441__L5_SUL_59__7776094E.mp3.translation: 清掉入口的敌人！丢两颗手雷应该就够了！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 清掉入口的敌人！丢两颗手雷应该就够了！

0443__L5_SUL_50__76F735C5.mp3.asr_text: Come on, Marines! Let's get up there and give them hell!
0443__L5_SUL_50__76F735C5.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，冲上去，给他们点厉害！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，冲上去，给他们点厉害！

0445__L5_POL_52__209C7764.mp3.asr_text: Look how they're dug into that rock! No wonder the Navy couldn't hit them!
0445__L5_POL_52__209C7764.mp3.translation: 看他们把炮藏进岩石里了！难怪海军打不着！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 看他们把炮藏进岩石里了！难怪海军打不着！

0447__L5_SUL_46__7596EA2C.mp3.asr_text: We got him on the run now!

0448__L5_POL_47__1F2E144A.mp3.asr_text: You hear that? We're getting close to those guns now.
0448__L5_POL_47__1F2E144A.mp3.translation: 听见没？离那些炮不远了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 听见没？离那些炮不远了。

0449__L5_POL_30__1D169724.mp3.asr_text: Good job, Miller. You're becoming a one-man slaughterhouse, ain't you?
0449__L5_POL_30__1D169724.mp3.translation: 干得好，米勒。你一个人都快赶上屠宰场了。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 干得好，米勒。你一个人都快赶上屠宰场了。

0450__L5_SUL_20__71D8ABE8.mp3.asr_text: Push up! Don't stop for anything!

0452__L5_POL_64__226D7F05.mp3.asr_text: Look at all these maps. We hit the jackpot, boys. Battalion's gonna love this, I'm telling you.
0452__L5_POL_64__226D7F05.mp3.translation: 瞧瞧这些地图。弟兄们，捡到宝了！营部要高兴坏。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 瞧瞧这些地图。弟兄们，捡到宝了！营部要高兴坏。

0453__L5_SUL_65__78F283E9.mp3.asr_text: Some jackpot. More like booby traps. Don't touch anything.
0453__L5_SUL_65__78F283E9.mp3.translation: 什么宝，诡雷还差不多，别乱碰。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 什么宝，诡雷还差不多，别乱碰。

0456__L5_ROE_3__09C24183.mp3.asr_text: At the 27th, they're going nowhere fast. We got Japanese dug in hard all across the front, and hell if they haven't managed to hide a couple of 88s up there, too. They're pounding the life out of our boys.
0456__L5_ROE_3__09C24183.mp3.translation: 二十七师，寸步难行。日军把整条战线守得死死的，上头居然还藏了几门八八炮，咱们的人快被炸光了。
0456__L5_ROE_3__09C24183.mp3.note: ASR句首At the 27th疑似That's the 27th，结合上下文译为指认二十七师。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 二十七师，寸步难行。日军把整条战线守得死死的，上头居然还藏了几门八八炮，咱们的人快被炸光了。

0457__L5_ROE_4__09D05904.mp3.asr_text: I want those guns silent, Sergeant. Now take your men and push on. See if you can work your way around.
0457__L5_ROE_4__09D05904.mp3.translation: 中士，我要那些炮闭嘴。带上你的人继续推进，看看能不能绕过去。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 中士，我要那些炮闭嘴。带上你的人继续推进，看看能不能绕过去。

0458__L5_POL_5__53A1314A.mp3.asr_text: Know how many caves they got up on that mountain, Captain? Those guns could be hidden anywhere up there.
0458__L5_POL_5__53A1314A.mp3.translation: 上尉，知道那座山上有多少洞吗？那些炮可能藏在任何地方。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 上尉，知道那座山上有多少洞吗？那些炮可能藏在任何地方。

0459__L5_ROE_6__09EC8806.mp3.asr_text: Artillery guns make noise, Polonsky. Just follow the noise, you'll find the guns. That's why the Marine Corps issued you with a pair of ears, remember?
0459__L5_ROE_6__09EC8806.mp3.translation: 炮会响，波隆斯基。顺着声音找，就能找到炮。陆战队给你配这对耳朵就是干这个的，记得吧？

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 炮会响，波隆斯基。顺着声音找，就能找到炮。陆战队给你配这对耳朵就是干这个的，记得吧？

0460__L5_MA1_7__B78FF71C.mp3.asr_text: Yeah, too bad they gave him that big mouth at the same time.
0460__L5_MA1_7__B78FF71C.mp3.translation: 可惜配耳朵的时候，还给他配了张大嘴。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 可惜配耳朵的时候，还给他配了张大嘴。

0461__L5_ROE_8__0A08B708.mp3.asr_text: Get to it, Marines! Let's just go up there and silence those guns!
0461__L5_ROE_8__0A08B708.mp3.translation: 弟兄们，行动！上去端掉那些炮！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 弟兄们，行动！上去端掉那些炮！

0463__L5_SUL_78__7AD1A30B.mp3.asr_text: Two things we ain't short on around here, Polonsky. Islands and enemies. This still ain't over.
0463__L5_SUL_78__7AD1A30B.mp3.translation: 波隆斯基，这儿有两样东西不缺：岛，还有敌人。这仗还没打完呢。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 波隆斯基，这儿有两样东西不缺：岛，还有敌人。这仗还没打完呢。

0467__L5_SUL_55__773DAB4A.mp3.asr_text: Polonsky, get a satchel charge into that bunker!
0467__L5_SUL_55__773DAB4A.mp3.translation: 波隆斯基，把炸药包扔进那个碉堡！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 波隆斯基，把炸药包扔进那个碉堡！

0468__L5_POL_56__20D4D568.mp3.asr_text: Cover me! I ain't delivering newspapers here!
0468__L5_POL_56__20D4D568.mp3.translation: 掩护我！我可不是去送报纸的！

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 掩护我！我可不是去送报纸的！

0470__L5_SUL_60__78AC0E64.mp3.asr_text: Miller, check it out. We're right behind you.
0470__L5_SUL_60__78AC0E64.mp3.translation: 米勒，去看看。我们就在后面。

voice_work_source.applied_translation: 米勒，去看看。我们就在后面。
